company_name: Dah Young Vacuum Equipment Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Dah Young Vacuum specializes in PVD and PECVD technologies critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Dah Young Vacuum Equipment Co., Ltd. provides high-precision coating solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on plasma-resistant coatings that enhance the longevity and stability of manufacturing components. With a strong R&D foundation and certification as a supplier to TSMC, the company delivers innovative and reliable equipment to global production lines.
capabilities: Plasma-resistant coating systems for semiconductor process components

regional_presence.Taiwan: Dah Young was certified as a supplier to TSMC, indicating a strategic presence in Taiwan's semiconductor ecosystem.
